templates.trigger: New verification challenge or explicit resend
templates.subject: Your Influrios verification code
templates.preheader: Confirm your email address to continue.
templates.title: Verify your email
body: Enter this code in Influrios to confirm your email address.
It expires in {{expires_in}}. Never share this code. Influrios will not ask you to send it by email or message.
If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.
templates.guard: Current inventory says 30 minutes. Use actual challenge expiry; suppress expired or superseded codes. Email verification does not verify a social account.

templates.subject: Verify your email for your Influrios Card
templates.preheader: One more step to continue claiming your card.
templates.title: Continue claiming your card
body: Enter this code in the card claim screen to confirm access to this email address.
This step verifies your email. It does not verify ownership of a social media account or publish your card.
If you did not start this request, you can ignore this email.
templates.guard: Use actual card challenge expiry; do not inherit account OTP lifetime unless implementation matches.

templates.subject: Reset your Influrios password
templates.preheader: Your password reset link expires in {{expires_in}}.
templates.title: Choose a new password
body: We received a request to reset your Influrios password. Use the button below to choose a new one.
If you did not request this, ignore this email. Your password will stay the same unless you complete the reset.
templates.guard: 30 minutes in inventory. Single-use token, rate limits, neutral request response. No automatic login or change on GET.

templates.subject: Set up your Influrios admin account
templates.preheader: You have been invited to join the Influrios admin team.
templates.title: Your admin invitation
body: {{inviter_name}} invited you to join the Influrios admin team with the role shown below. Set up your account to accept the invitation.
If you were not expecting this invitation, contact the person who invited you before continuing.
templates.guard: Current lifetime 7 days; render actual expiry. Require inviter permission and assigned role validity. Never send a temporary password.

templates.subject: {{first_name}}, create your Influrios Card
templates.preheader: Review your invitation and build your influencer profile.
templates.title: Your influence in one place
body: You are invited to create an Influrios Card: a shareable profile that brings your specialties and social links together.
Review any prefilled details and choose what to publish. Claiming a card does not verify a social account.
templates.guard: Do not claim a ready or verified profile unless it exists. Send only under approved outreach policy; unsubscribe and suppression required.

templates.subject: Your Influrios Card invitation is still open
templates.preheader: You can still review your invitation before it expires.
templates.title: A reminder about your card
body: Your invitation to create an Influrios Card is still available. Review the details and decide whether you would like to continue.
You choose what to publish. If this is not for you, you can stop these invitations below.
templates.guard: One follow-up proposed, at most; only unclaimed, unexpired, not unsubscribed, no reply or complaint. Ignore stale stored follow-up dates.

templates.subject: Welcome to Influrios, {{first_name}}
templates.preheader: Build your profile and get ready for collaborations.
templates.title: Welcome to Influrios
body: Your account is ready. Start by adding your specialty, location and a short introduction. Then preview your Influrios Card before publishing it.
You can connect your social accounts when you are ready. Email verification and social account verification are separate steps.
templates.guard: Send once after email verification, or equivalent trusted email proof. Do not imply the profile is published or payouts enabled.

templates.trigger: First business account email verification completed
templates.subject: Welcome to Influrios, {{first_name}}
templates.preheader: Set up your business profile and plan your first collaboration.
templates.title: Meet your next collaborator
body: Your business account is ready. Add your company details, discover influencers and prepare a collaboration request.
You can review your brief and select invitees before sending invitations. Funding becomes available only when the agreement is signed and the payment route is eligible.
templates.guard: Send once; feature links must exist and be authorized.

templates.subject: Your Influrios password was changed
templates.preheader: Review this change if you did not make it.
templates.title: Password updated
body: Your Influrios password was changed at {{changed_at}}.
If you made this change, no action is needed. If you did not, open Influrios directly and secure your account, or contact support.
templates.guard: Recommended new security email. No passwords, tokens or device claims without evidence.

templates.subject: [TEST] Influrios email delivery check
templates.preheader: This is a test message, not an account or payment notification.
templates.title: Your email test arrived
body: This message was requested from Influrios admin to check outgoing email delivery. It does not confirm that a collaboration, payment or account action occurred.
If you did not expect this test, no action is needed.
templates.guard: Allowlisted test recipients; rate limit; no live OTPs or real action tokens.

templates.subject: {{business_name}} invited you to collaborate
templates.preheader: Review the brief, proposed budget and timing.
templates.title: You have a collaboration invitation
body: {{business_name}} would like to collaborate with you on {{collaboration_name}}. Review the brief and proposed terms before responding.
Accepting an invitation starts the discussion. It does not sign a contract or confirm funding.
templates.guard: One private recipient per send. Proposed amount label; show estimated fees only if valid quote exists. Do not include other invitees.

templates.subject: Private invitation from {{business_name}}
templates.preheader: You have been invited to review {{campaign_name}}.
templates.title: A campaign invitation for you
body: {{business_name}} invited you to consider {{campaign_name}}. Open the invitation to review the brief, deliverables and proposed compensation.
Your response is shared with the business. Other invitees are not listed in this email.
templates.guard: Use instead of collaboration invite when same invitation event is a private campaign; never send both.

templates.subject: {{influencer_name}} accepted your invitation
templates.preheader: Continue the conversation and agree on the details.
templates.title: Your invitation was accepted
body: {{influencer_name}} accepted the invitation for {{collaboration_name}}.
Review the next steps together and prepare the agreement when the scope, dates and compensation are confirmed. Work is not funded yet.
templates.guard: Invitation accepted is not contract signed or work authorized.

templates.subject: Invitation update for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: {{influencer_name}} declined this invitation.
templates.title: Invitation declined
body: {{influencer_name}} declined your invitation for {{collaboration_name}}. You can update the brief or invite another influencer.
No agreement was signed or payment collected through this invitation.
templates.guard: Only invitation stage; suppress final sentence if any downstream agreement exists.

templates.subject: {{sender_name}} invited you to a team proposal
templates.preheader: Review your proposed role before responding.
templates.title: Review your team proposal
body: {{sender_name}} invited you to join {{team_name}} for {{collaboration_name}}. Review your proposed role, responsibilities and terms.
Accepting this proposal does not authorize a payment or sign a collaboration agreement.
templates.guard: Feature-gated. Limit details to this recipient; do not enable team funding by enabling email.

templates.subject: {{recipient_name}} accepted the team proposal
templates.preheader: The proposal response is available in Influrios.
templates.title: Team proposal accepted
body: {{recipient_name}} accepted the proposal for {{team_name}}. Review the team details and any remaining responses before moving forward.
templates.guard: Feature-gated; do not disclose other members beyond authorized team visibility.

templates.subject: Team proposal declined by {{recipient_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the proposal and decide on the next step.
templates.title: Team proposal declined
body: {{recipient_name}} declined the proposal for {{team_name}}. You can review the proposal and update your team plans.
templates.guard: Feature-gated; optional decline reason stays in authenticated app.

templates.subject: Team proposal expired for {{team_name}}
templates.preheader: The response deadline has passed.
templates.title: This proposal has expired
body: The team proposal for {{team_name}} expired on {{expires_at}}. It can no longer be accepted.
Open the proposal to see its status. A new invitation is needed to continue.
templates.guard: Feature-gated; recheck pending state; no send if already accepted or declined.

templates.subject: Action needed: sign {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the agreement before signing.
templates.title: Your agreement is ready
body: The agreement for {{collaboration_name}} is ready for your review. Check the deliverables, schedule, compensation and fees before signing.
All required parties must sign before funding can begin.
templates.guard: Use one sender owner for native or DocuSign request; do not duplicate provider invitations. Signing link opens correct version and recipient.

templates.subject: Signature update for {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: {{signer_name}} has signed the agreement.
templates.title: One step closer
body: {{signer_name}} signed {{contract_name}}. {{remaining_signers_text}}
Funding can begin only after every required signature is complete and payment eligibility checks pass.
templates.guard: Suppress on final signature; use fully signed instead. Only parties may see signer names.

templates.subject: Reminder: your signature is needed
templates.preheader: {{contract_name}} is waiting for your review.
templates.title: Your signature is still needed
body: Please review {{contract_name}} and sign if you agree with its terms. The current signature deadline is {{expires_at}}.
If the agreement needs changes, contact the other party through Influrios before signing.
templates.guard: Only outstanding signer/current version; proposed max two reminders; provider sender owner avoids duplicates.

templates.subject: Fully signed: {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: Your agreement is signed. Review the funding step.
templates.title: Your agreement is fully signed
body: All required parties have signed {{contract_name}}. The signed copy is available in Influrios.
Open the agreement to review funding eligibility and the amount due. The influencer should wait for funding confirmation before starting paid work.
templates.guard: Use snapshot amount. Merge funding-required email when prefund is created in same transaction; do not promise eligible route.

templates.subject: Fully signed: {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: The next step is business funding.
templates.title: Your agreement is fully signed
body: All required parties have signed {{contract_name}}. You can view the signed agreement in Influrios.
The business now needs to complete funding. We will notify you when the required funds are confirmed and work can begin.
templates.guard: Show signed role-specific fees; legacy fee label preserved. Do not say paid.

templates.subject: Agreement declined: {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: The agreement has not been completed.
templates.title: Agreement declined
body: {{signer_name}} declined {{contract_name}}. This version is not fully signed.
Open the agreement to review the response and discuss any changes before issuing a new version.
templates.guard: Only valid decline transition; no assumptions about refund or existing funded versions.

templates.subject: Agreement voided: {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: This agreement version can no longer be signed.
templates.title: Agreement voided
body: Version {{agreement_version}} of {{contract_name}} has been voided. Do not use an earlier signing link for this version.
If this collaboration has payment activity, its cancellation or refund status is shown separately in Influrios.
templates.guard: Voiding does not itself refund money; expiry/void event must be authoritative.

templates.subject: New message about {{contract_name}}
templates.preheader: {{sender_name}} sent you a message in Influrios.
templates.title: You have a new message
body: {{sender_name}} sent a message about {{contract_name}}:
{{message_excerpt}}
Open the conversation to read the full message and reply.
templates.guard: Escaped plain excerpt max 180 characters; sensitive-content mode omits excerpt. Batch bursts within 5 minutes; no reply-by-email unless inbound handling exists.

templates.subject: Quote expiring for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the quote before {{expires_at}}.
templates.title: Your quote is expiring
body: The current quote for {{collaboration_name}} expires on {{expires_at}}. Review it and complete the required steps if you want to proceed.
After expiry, the amounts and payment eligibility must be checked again before a new quote is accepted.
templates.guard: No send after full signing or expiry. Suppress overlapping signature reminder; one expiry reminder by default.

templates.subject: Review a change to {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The proposed changes need your agreement.
templates.title: A change has been proposed
body: {{sender_name}} proposed a change to {{collaboration_name}}.
{{change_summary}}
The existing signed terms remain in effect until the required approvals and signatures are complete.
templates.guard: No direct signed-gross edits. Do not send accepted wording on draft save.

templates.subject: Change confirmed for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Your updated agreement is available.
templates.title: Your agreement has been updated
body: The required parties have accepted and signed the changes for {{collaboration_name}}. Version {{agreement_version}} is now the current agreement.
Review the updated scope, schedule and your financial breakdown. Any additional funding or refund has its own payment status.
templates.guard: Accepted means executable signed amendment; do not imply additional funds received.

templates.subject: Funding needed for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Review your payment breakdown and fund the collaboration.
templates.title: Fund your collaboration
body: Your agreement is signed. Complete the funding step for {{collaboration_name}} so the influencer can begin once the provider confirms the required funds.
Review the payment details before continuing.
templates.guard: Render actual signed policy labels; hide inapplicable rows. Suppress if fully-signed business email already covers same action.

templates.subject: Complete funding for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Your funding step is still open.
templates.title: Continue your funding
body: Funding for {{collaboration_name}} is not yet confirmed. Open the secure payment page to continue or review the payment instructions.
If you have already submitted a payment, check its status before trying again. Do not make a second transfer.
templates.guard: One reminder only after configured delay and pending-state check. Bank instructions stay in authenticated portal; never invent bank details or initiate new checkout on email GET.

templates.trigger: Provider accepts collection for asynchronous processing
templates.subject: Payment processing for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Your payment is being checked. No second payment is needed.
templates.title: Your payment is processing
body: Your payment for {{collaboration_name}} is processing. The required funds have not yet been confirmed as available for this collaboration.
Do not submit another payment. We will send a confirmation when the funding check is complete.
templates.guard: Recommended new template for async collections; never infer hold from checkout return.

templates.subject: Funding confirmed for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The required funds are confirmed and work can begin.
templates.title: Your collaboration is funded
body: The payment provider has confirmed the required funds for {{collaboration_name}}. The influencer can now begin the agreed work.
Review submissions in your collaboration workspace. Milestone approval and payout confirmation are separate steps.
templates.guard: Only approved hold proof; not generic charge success. No escrow claim by default.

templates.subject: You can begin {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Funding is confirmed for your agreed work.
templates.title: Ready to begin
body: The required funding for {{collaboration_name}} has been confirmed. You can now begin the work described in your agreement.
Check the deliverables and due dates, then submit each version through the collaboration workspace.
templates.guard: Net is planned contract compensation, not already paid. Do not include business-only fees.

templates.subject: Funding did not complete for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the payment status before trying again.
templates.title: Your funding needs attention
body: The payment provider could not complete funding for {{collaboration_name}}. Work has not been cleared to start from this payment.
{{safe_next_step}}
templates.guard: Only definitive failure, not timeout. Next step server-selected from safe reason; no raw provider error or automatic new charge.

templates.trigger: Unpaid checkout definitively expired by admin or provider
templates.subject: Funding link expired for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the collaboration to see the next available step.
templates.title: Your funding link has expired
body: The unpaid funding link for {{collaboration_name}} has expired and can no longer be used.
Open the collaboration to review the current agreement and funding options. Expiring a payment link does not by itself cancel the agreement.
templates.guard: Reconcile pending/unknown charges first. Covers admin expiry gap; do not send collaboration-cancelled unless actually cancelled.

templates.trigger: Influencer submits a named delivery version
templates.subject: Ready for review: {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: {{influencer_name}} submitted work for {{collaboration_name}}.
templates.title: Your review is needed
body: {{influencer_name}} submitted {{milestone_name}} for {{collaboration_name}}. Review the files and check them against the agreed brief.
You can approve the submission or request a revision in the workspace. If there is a problem that needs formal review, you can open a dispute there.
templates.guard: Delivery status only; no payment promises. Review time shown with timezone.

templates.subject: Review due soon: {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: Please review the submission by {{review_due_at}}.
templates.title: A review deadline is approaching
body: {{milestone_name}} is waiting for your review. Please approve the submitted version or request a revision before {{review_due_at}}.
{{deadline_policy_text}}
templates.guard: Once per submission/version threshold. Stop on revision, approval or dispute. Policy text from signed rule; never threaten auto-approval when disabled.

templates.subject: Revision requested for {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the feedback and submit an updated version.
templates.title: A revision is needed
body: {{business_name}} requested a revision to {{milestone_name}}.
{{revision_note}}
Review the full feedback and submit the updated version in your collaboration workspace.
templates.guard: Escaped excerpt; due date only if actually agreed. Link latest version, preserve history.

templates.subject: Approved: {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: The submission is approved. Payout has a separate status.
templates.title: Milestone approved
body: {{milestone_name}} for {{collaboration_name}} has been approved.
Approval confirms the work review. It does not confirm that a payout has reached the influencer. Payment progress is available in Influrios.
templates.guard: Exactly once per approval transition. Must not be reused when only a payout request occurs.

templates.subject: Review period ended for {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: The milestone was automatically approved under the agreement.
templates.title: Milestone automatically approved
body: The review period for {{milestone_name}} ended on {{review_due_at}}. Under the automatic approval terms in your agreement, this submission has been approved.
Payout has a separate status. Open the collaboration to review the timeline and available support options.
templates.guard: Disabled unless feature AND signed policy allow auto-approval and no revision/dispute/hold blocks it. Do not enable this behavior just to send mail.

templates.subject: Payout processing for {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: Your payout has been submitted to the provider.
templates.title: Your payout is processing
body: Your payout for {{milestone_name}} has been submitted to the payment provider. It is not yet confirmed as paid.
We will notify you when the provider confirms the outcome. You can follow its progress in Influrios.
templates.guard: Provider acceptance, not internal queue creation. No guaranteed arrival time; separate queued state if useful.

templates.subject: Payout processing for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The approved milestone payout is with the provider.
templates.title: Milestone payout in progress
body: The payout for {{milestone_name}} has been submitted to the provider. It has not yet been confirmed as completed.
No additional funding is requested by this email.
templates.guard: No influencer bank data or private fees. Optional digest for non-actionable updates.

templates.subject: Payout confirmed for {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: The provider confirmed your {{payout_net}} payout.
templates.title: Your payout is confirmed
body: The provider confirmed the payout for {{milestone_name}} in {{collaboration_name}}. View your payment record for the breakdown.
If the payment is not visible in your account, check the payout details and contact support from that page.
templates.guard: Verified external beneficiary success, not wallet split. Usage-rights activation email requires separate actual rights event; do not promise automatic rights.

templates.subject: Milestone payout completed for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Payment for {{milestone_name}} is confirmed.
templates.title: Milestone payout completed
body: The provider confirmed the influencer payout for {{milestone_name}}. Your payment timeline and applicable fee receipt have been updated.
Check the agreement and rights status in the workspace before using the delivered content.
templates.guard: No blanket usage-rights promise. Role-specific receipt uses signed fee allocation.

templates.subject: Your payout needs attention
templates.preheader: The payout for {{milestone_name}} did not complete.
templates.title: Payout not completed
body: The provider could not complete your payout for {{milestone_name}}. Your approved work remains recorded.
{{safe_next_step}}
Check the payout page before changing your details or requesting a retry.
templates.guard: Only definitive failure. Updating bank details requires authenticated re-verification. No promise money is safe or retry scheduled without evidence.

templates.subject: [Finance] Payout failed: {{public_reference}}
templates.preheader: Reconcile the failure before creating another attempt.
templates.title: Payout failure requires review
body: A payout for {{collaboration_name}} failed. Review the provider result and reconcile the operation before retrying.
{{safe_failure_summary}}
templates.guard: Admin-only identifiers permitted but no credentials/full bank details. Do not reuse for retry.

templates.trigger: Provider accepts new authorized retry attempt
templates.subject: Payout retry started for {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: A new payout attempt is processing.
templates.title: We are retrying the payout
body: A new payout attempt for {{milestone_name}} has been submitted to the provider. The outcome is not yet confirmed.
Follow the payment timeline for updates. This retry is not a new charge to the business.
templates.guard: Known failed/returned prior attempt reconciled. No send when merely queued. Finance receives event in case timeline; optional internal digest.

templates.subject: Payout returned for {{milestone_name}}
templates.preheader: The provider reported that the earlier payout was returned.
templates.title: Your payout was returned
body: The provider reported that the earlier payout for {{milestone_name}} was returned. The returned amount is no longer treated as successfully paid.
Your approved work remains approved. Review the payment details so the payment issue can be resolved.
templates.guard: Support partial return amount. Reopen payment obligation, not delivery approval. No automatic request for business to fund again.

templates.subject: Payment update for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: A milestone payout was returned and needs resolution.
templates.title: A payout was returned
body: The provider reported a return affecting the payout for {{milestone_name}}. The payment obligation is being reviewed; the work approval remains recorded.
Do not send an additional payment unless a reviewed funding request is shown in Influrios.
templates.guard: Does not disclose bank reason/private fee. Admin uses dedicated exception below.

templates.subject: [Finance] Payout returned: {{public_reference}}
templates.preheader: Reconcile the returned amount and the remaining payment obligation.
templates.title: Returned payout requires review
body: The provider reported a payout return for {{collaboration_name}}. Reconcile the returned amount against the original operation, fee adjustments and outstanding beneficiary obligation.
Do not reset approved delivery or issue a duplicate full payout.
templates.guard: Operation-scoped return; identify partial return, incident dedupe and assigned owner.

templates.subject: Your payout setup is ready
templates.preheader: Your payout details have passed the required checks.
templates.title: Ready to receive payouts
body: Your payout setup for {{country_name}} has passed the required checks. You can receive eligible collaboration payouts through the enabled route.
This confirms your setup, not a payment. Each collaboration still needs funding, work approval and provider confirmation.
templates.guard: Define ambiguous Payout ready as recipient onboarding only. Require verified route readiness; separate payable-milestone concept.

templates.trigger: Dispute case opened and release hold applied
templates.subject: Dispute opened for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The affected milestone release is paused.
templates.title: A dispute is open
body: A dispute has been opened for {{milestone_name}}. New releases for the affected milestone are paused while the case is reviewed.
{{inflight_status_text}}
Open the case to review the issue and provide the requested information.
templates.guard: Pause must actually be applied. In-flight payment may still complete; disclose precise safe status. Admin gets case email separately.

templates.subject: [Action needed] New dispute: {{case_reference}}
templates.preheader: Assign an owner and review payment exposure.
templates.title: New dispute to review
body: A dispute has been opened for {{collaboration_name}} and {{milestone_name}}. Review the case, the release hold and any in-flight payment before taking action.
templates.guard: Only authorized operators; evidence and allegations stay in case.

templates.audience: Both parties and authorized case operators separately
templates.subject: Dispute outcome for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The decision is available in your case.
templates.title: Your dispute has an outcome
body: A resolution has been recorded for {{milestone_name}}.
{{resolution_summary}}
A decision does not itself complete a payment or refund. Any required money movement will be confirmed separately.
templates.guard: Separate withdrawn/settled/released resolution text from safe controlled values; no automatic paid claim. Admin case log records outcome.

templates.subject: Response overdue for dispute {{case_reference}}
templates.preheader: Please review the outstanding request in your case.
templates.title: Your response is overdue
body: The requested response for dispute {{case_reference}} was due on {{response_due_at}}. Please open the case and provide the outstanding information.
{{case_next_step}}
templates.guard: One per deadline/version; only owing party, not every party. Escalation separate admin alert; no invented penalties.

templates.subject: [Action needed] Dispute overdue: {{case_reference}}
templates.preheader: The case response or review deadline has passed.
templates.title: Dispute needs follow-up
body: The deadline for {{case_reference}} has passed. Check the outstanding actor, contact history and payment hold, then record the next action.
templates.guard: One alert per SLA threshold; explicit escalation schedule.

templates.audience: Other party and requesting party separately
templates.subject: Review cancellation for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: A settlement proposal is ready for your review.
templates.title: Review the cancellation proposal
body: A cancellation has been requested for {{collaboration_name}}. The proposed settlement is ready to review in Influrios.
It shows accepted work, any retained fees, outstanding payments and the proposed refund. Nothing is marked refunded by this email.
templates.guard: If only request exists and no proposal, use request_received. Each party sees authorized financial breakdown in app.

templates.subject: Cancellation requested for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The request is awaiting review.
templates.title: Cancellation under review
body: A cancellation request has been recorded for {{collaboration_name}}. The request and any payment activity must be reviewed before a settlement is confirmed.
We will notify you when a settlement proposal or further action is ready.
templates.guard: Do not say cancellation completed or refund due yet.

templates.subject: [Finance] Review cancellation: {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Check accepted work, fees and in-flight operations.
templates.title: Settlement review required
body: Review the cancellation request for {{collaboration_name}}. Confirm accepted work, applicable fee policy, previous payments and remaining refundable funds before publishing a settlement proposal.
templates.guard: Mandatory internal queue event; do not rely on email as sole work queue.

templates.subject: Cancellation update for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: We are waiting for the provider to confirm a payment outcome.
templates.title: Waiting for a payment update
body: Your cancellation settlement cannot be finalized yet because a payout is still processing.
Once the provider confirms the outcome, the settlement can be recalculated. Please do not make another payment while this is being checked.
templates.guard: One notice per blocking operation; notify finance via case queue with operation details.

templates.subject: Collaboration cancelled: {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the final settlement and any remaining payment steps.
templates.title: Your collaboration is cancelled
body: {{collaboration_name}} has been cancelled under the recorded terms.
{{settlement_status_text}}
The settlement page shows any accepted work, retained fees, outstanding payout or refund. Payment completion is confirmed separately.
templates.guard: Unfunded version uses no-money-collected text only after reconciliation. Cancellation effective may precede refund success; do not conflate financial closure.

templates.subject: Refund processing for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Your {{refund_amount}} refund is with the payment provider.
templates.title: Your refund is processing
body: A refund of {{refund_amount}} has been submitted for {{collaboration_name}}. It has not yet been confirmed as completed.
You can review the settlement and follow the refund status in Influrios.
templates.guard: Recommended new message; provider accepted not merely queued. No universal arrival promise.

templates.subject: Refund confirmed for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The provider confirmed a refund of {{refund_amount}}.
templates.title: Your refund is confirmed
body: The provider confirmed the refund shown below for {{collaboration_name}}. Your settlement explains the accepted work and retained charges.
Your bank or payment method may take additional time to display the credit.
templates.guard: Normal currency units with code. Use signed settlement amounts; omit irrelevant rows. Partial refund is not whole deal refunded.

templates.trigger: Verified business refund relevant to own agreement
templates.subject: Settlement update for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: The business refund has been confirmed.
templates.title: Your settlement has been updated
body: The provider confirmed the business refund associated with {{collaboration_name}}.
Your settlement page shows your accepted compensation, applicable fees, payments already made and any remaining amount due to you.
templates.guard: No business card or bank data. Show only own authorized economics; does not say influencer received refund.

templates.subject: Payment review for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Some payment actions are paused while a payment issue is reviewed.
templates.title: Payment actions are paused
body: A payment issue affecting {{collaboration_name}} is being reviewed. New releases covered by the restriction are paused.
{{safe_next_step}}
This notice does not confirm a refund or decide fault between the parties.
templates.guard: Neutral safe reason; no raw fraud allegations. In-flight funds reconciled separately; notify finance risk queue.

templates.subject: Activation fee update for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Your activation service and fee status are recorded.
templates.title: Your collaboration is activated
body: The activation service for {{collaboration_name}} has been completed. The applicable Platform Activation Fee is shown below.
{{activation_policy_text}}
Collaboration service fees follow the milestone settlement terms in your agreement.
templates.guard: Optional receipt; combine with funding confirmed if same moment. Only new fee policy with funding AND activation evidence; no unconditional nonrefundable language.

templates.subject: [Review needed] Relationship claim for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the claim before applying any policy change.
templates.title: Relationship claim submitted
body: A pre-existing relationship claim was submitted for {{collaboration_name}}. Review the supporting information and the applicable policy.
The claim does not automatically change signed fees or payment obligations.
templates.guard: No automatic attribution or fee rewrite.

templates.trigger: User action blocked by unavailable route
templates.subject: Funding unavailable for {{collaboration_name}}
templates.preheader: This collaboration cannot start funded work yet.
templates.title: Funding is currently unavailable
body: Funding for {{collaboration_name}} could not be started because {{safe_route_reason}}.
{{safe_next_step}}
Please wait for an eligible funding option before beginning paid work.
templates.guard: Use explicit country/eligibility safe reason; do not send operational ledger alerts to both parties. Repeated button clicks deduped.

templates.subject: [Finance] Route blocked for {{country_name}}
templates.preheader: Review the route capability or configuration issue.
templates.title: Payment route needs review
body: A funding action was blocked for {{collaboration_name}}. Review the route, country checks and provider capability evidence.
Do not bypass the holding or beneficiary verification requirements to clear this alert.
templates.guard: One incident per route/blocker/version; config RBAC. Do not send for ordinary expected ineligibility unless threshold/action required.

templates.subject: [Finance] Unpaid funding needs review
templates.preheader: {{collaboration_name}} has an unresolved funding attempt.
templates.title: Review unpaid funding
body: The funding attempt for {{collaboration_name}} has remained unpaid beyond the configured review window. Check for an in-flight or unknown provider operation before expiring it or contacting the business.
templates.guard: Separate from country limitation; once per age threshold. Never auto-cancel unknown payment.

templates.subject: [Urgent finance review] Payment balance mismatch
templates.preheader: Reconcile the affected operation before further money movement.
templates.title: Reconciliation needs attention
body: A reconciliation mismatch was detected for {{collaboration_name}}. Review the internal journal and provider evidence before allowing further affected money movement.
templates.guard: No customer-facing ledger jargon. Lock actual affected operations; incident dedupe and escalation; no secrets in email.

templates.subject: [Finance] Held funds need review
templates.preheader: Review the holding timeline for {{collaboration_name}}.
templates.title: Review held funds
body: Funds for {{collaboration_name}} have reached the configured holding review threshold. Review the agreement, delivery progress, disputes and provider requirements.
Do not release or refund funds automatically because this warning was sent.
templates.guard: Provider/route-specific threshold; once per threshold and incident; no invented provider limits.

templates.subject: Receipt for your Influrios {{plan_name}} plan
templates.preheader: Your subscription payment is confirmed.
templates.title: Your plan payment is confirmed
body: Your payment for the {{plan_name}} plan is confirmed. You can view the invoice and manage your subscription from Billing.
This payment is for your Influrios subscription. It does not fund a collaboration.
templates.guard: Choose Stripe OR Influrios as receipt owner. Confirm paid event and actual plan state; no duplicate invoice-paid subscription message.

templates.subject: Action needed for your Influrios subscription
templates.preheader: Update your payment details to resolve the unpaid invoice.
templates.title: Your subscription payment failed
body: We could not complete the payment for your {{plan_name}} subscription. Open Billing to review the invoice and update your payment method.
{{subscription_access_text}}
templates.guard: Single owner with Stripe; access and retry dates from actual billing state, not invented grace period.

templates.subject: Your Influrios plan renews on {{renewal_date}}
templates.preheader: Review your plan and upcoming charge.
templates.title: Your renewal is coming up
body: Your {{plan_name}} plan is scheduled to renew on {{renewal_date}}. Review your upcoming invoice and manage your subscription in Billing.
{{renewal_amount_note}}
templates.guard: Recommended addition. Label estimated amount when tax/usage unsettled. Recheck cancellation and sender owner before sending.

templates.subject: Your Influrios subscription cancellation is scheduled
templates.preheader: Your current plan ends on {{plan_end_at}}.
templates.title: Cancellation scheduled
body: Your {{plan_name}} subscription is scheduled to end on {{plan_end_at}}. {{subscription_access_text}}
This change affects your subscription. Existing collaboration agreements and payment obligations remain separate.
templates.guard: Recommended addition. Do not say already cancelled when scheduled; no refund promise.

templates.subject: Your Influrios subscription has ended
templates.preheader: Review your current plan and available features.
templates.title: Your subscription has ended
body: Your {{plan_name}} subscription ended on {{plan_end_at}}. {{current_plan_text}}
Your existing collaboration agreements and payment obligations remain separate.
templates.guard: Recommended addition; actual entitlement state only.

templates.subject: Bring your influencer profile together with Influrios
templates.preheader: Build a shareable card with your specialty and social links.
templates.title: Make your profile easier to share
body: Your Influrios Card brings your specialty, introduction and social links into one shareable profile.
Review your details, preview your card and choose what to publish. You can update your profile as your work grows.
templates.guard: Editorial template, not automatic event. Require final copy, lawful audience/consent, sender/address, unsubscribe, test and authorized send. No live sends in this handoff.
